versions.ephemeris: JPL Horizons DE441, MOON_ME, 2027-Jan-01 00:00 to 2031-Dec-31 23:00 UTC hourly

rules.azimuth: true, clockwise from north; bin k covers [k, k+1) deg, value = max of 4 sub-rays; look up between centres k+0.5
rules.reach: auto: ray stops when even the DEM maximum could not rise above the horizon found, or at the grid edge
rules.sun_pct: mean visible fraction of the Sun's disc (radius 0.2666 deg)
rules.earth: visible if any part of a 0.95 deg disc is above the mask; geometry only, not a radio link
rules.ground: site height from the 20 m DEM; 20 m terrain within near range, 80 m beyond
